name: Corrilário
body:
Corrilário CR
4

A large dog, its muzzle crusty with dried blood and its eyes glowing red in dim light, advances slowly and deliberately towards you, but its demeanor doesn’t seem so threatening.

XP 1,200
CG Medium undead
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft., ghostsense, scent; Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural)
hp 37 (5d8+15)
Fort +3, Ref +3, Will +7

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee bite +8 (1d6+4 plus trip), 2 claws +8 (1d4+4)
Special Attacks go for the throat, guardian spirit, werewolf hunter

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 15, Con —, Int 10, Wis 17, Cha 14
Base Atk +3; CMB +7; CMD 19 (23 vs. trip)
Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Toughness
Skills Climb +10, Perception +11 (+16 vs. lycanthropes), Sense Motive +5 (+10 vs. lycanthropes), Stealth +10, Survival +12 (+17 vs. lycanthropes); Racial Modifiers +4 Survival
Languages Common (cannot speak)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Ghostsense (Su)

A corrilário can sense the location of incorporeal creatures within 30 feet as if it had blindsight, including incorporeal creatures inside of solid objects or creatures, as long as they are within 5 feet of the surface.

Go For the Throat (Ex)

Against a foe it successfully tripped, a corrilário may make a free extra bite attack in the same round.

If the attack hits, it deals normal damage plus 1d6 bleed damage.

Guardian Spirit (Su)

When an ally within 30 feet of the corrilário takes damage from an effect that targets it, as an immediate action it can shift into the Ethereal Plane and leap to its comrade’s aid. The corrilário rematerializes in the path of the blow, spell, or effect, which deals half damage to the corrilário and half damage to the original target. If the attacker is within the corrilário’s reach after it intercepts the attack, it can make a bite attack against that creature as part of the immediate action. After using this ability, it must wait 1d4 rounds before using it again.

Werewolf Hunter (Su)

A corrilário has a +5 competence bonus on Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks against lycanthropes. In addition, its natural attacks are treated as silver and magic weapons and can damage incorporeal creatures as if they had the ghost touch property.

Woodland Stride (Ex)

Like a druid, a corrilário may move through any sort of undergrowth (such as natural thorns, briars, overgrown areas, and similar terrain) at its normal speed and without taking damage or suffering any other impairment. Thorns, briars, and overgrown areas that have been magically manipulated to impede motion, however, still affect it.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary or pack (2-4)
Treasure incidental

A corrilário is not a beast but rather an incarnation of a lost soul. Corrilários are formed when an exceptionally willful humanoid is killed by a werewolf, or occasionally when such a humanoid dies after losing those dearest to them to a werewolf attack. The urge for retribution returns them to corporeal form, that of a great, wolfish dog. In this form, the corrilário prowls the woodlands, searching for werewolves to destroy.

While fearsome in appearance, the corrilário seeks to destroy werewolves and protect others from the depredations of such creatures. Tales are told of lost children or travelers being led out of the woods to safety by large dogs, often after the hound interrupts a werewolf attack, killing or driving the lycanthrope away.

When a corrilário’s unlife ends, its body withers and crumbles to dust.

The duration of a corrilário’s time in the world is an uncertain thing.

Some linger only long enough to end the life of the werewolf that killed them or their loved one. Others might remain for months, years, or even decades, protecting a particular person, family, settlement, or area until those it protects are no more or it is defeated.
